title: ⚡ Flash Heard | Another Risk to Fuel Prices: U.S. Refinery Outages
summary: As surging diesel and gasoline prices demonstrate, global refining capacity is tight.  On Monday, ExxonMobil said that it had to shut down its Joliet refinery in Illinois after a power outage, according to OPIS.  The outage occurred around 3:30 p.m. Central Time on Sunday, with power restored around 7 p.m. The refinery has a capacity of 275,000 barrels a day and makes up about 6% of overall refining capacity in the Midwest, according to the company’s fact sheet.
